# `bank-feed-connection` commands

## `bank-feed-connection add`

Add a disabled per-account feed connection with non-secret settings and an OS keyring secret_ref. No providers are registered in this build; unknown kinds refuse. Example: {"name":"Checking feed","kind":"unavailable","account":"Checking","remote_account":"checking"}.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | bank-feed.connect |
| Additional resources | bank-feed: member, ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/bank-feed-connection.add` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow bank-feed-connection add --name "Checking feed" --kind unavailable --account Checking --remote-account checking --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Set up feed" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "bank-feed-connection add", "input": {"name": "Checking feed", "kind": "unavailable", "account": "Checking", "remote_account": "checking"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `--name` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1; maximum length 100 |
| `kind` | `--kind` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1; maximum length 64 |
| `account` | `--account` | string | yes | no | — | Bank or credit card account ID or canonical full name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1000 |
| `remote_account` | `--remote-account` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1; maximum length 255 |
| `settings` | `--settings` | object[string, any] | no | no | {} | Provider-validated non-secret settings. |
| `secret_ref` | `--secret-ref` | string \| null | no | yes | null | OS keyring reference keyring:service/name, never the secret. |

## `bank-feed-connection enable`

Enable fetching on this host. The first page requires confirm equal to the staged preview fingerprint. A restored connection is disabled. Example: {"connection":"Checking feed"}.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

## `bank-feed-connection query`

List account connections and available provider kinds (none in this build); never read a secret or contact a provider. Live bank connections are not available yet; use bank-feed import with a statement file. Do not request bank credentials.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | bank-feed |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/bank-feed-connection.query` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow bank-feed-connection query --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "bank-feed-connection query", "input": {}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 100 | minimum 1; maximum 500 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/bank-feed-connection.query`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.
